welcome.headline: WELCOME TO MY BRAND
welcome.introText: I'm a multidisciplinary creator working across motion graphics, product design, UI/UX, and AI-driven development. My work bridges bold brand storytelling with functional, technology-first execution — for founders, creators, and EdTech brands alike.

introduction.headline: INTRODUCTION
introduction.text: With a B.Tech in Computer Science and hands-on experience across brand advertising, motion storytelling, and AI development, I bring a rare mix of design sensibility and technical depth to every project I take on.

aboutMe.headline: ABOUT ME
aboutMe.text: My mission is to turn ideas into powerful digital experiences. I combine design, technology, and AI into one integrated skillset — moving fluidly between motion graphics, UI/UX design, and Python-driven automation. I'm currently building a future-ready studio where designers, developers, and AI systems work as one.
